title: Daily Routine
text: Hi! I am Leo and I am nine years old. My day is very busy and fun! I wake up at seven in the morning. First, I brush my teeth and get dressed. Then, I eat breakfast. I usually eat yummy cereal with milk! I go to school at half past eight. I love learning new things! After school, I do my homework. Sometimes I play football with my friends in the park. In the evening, I have dinner with my family. After dinner, I read a book or watch television. Finally, I go to bed at nine. It is a very good day! I am very happy right now!

title: Family and Friends
text: Hi! I am Leo and I am nine years old. My family is really important to me. I have a mum, a dad, and a little sister called Mia. Mia is six and she is very funny! I also have lots of great friends. My best friend is Sam. We love playing football and building blocks together. We often play in the park after school. I also like playing with Chloe and Ben. Chloe is good at art and Ben loves telling jokes! We all always have fun together, and I am lucky to have such a wonderful family and friends. I love them so very much every single day!

title: Animals and Pets
text: Hi! I am Leo and I love animals! I have a golden dog called Buddy. He is so fluffy and loves to play fetch. Buddy is my best pet ever! I also really like wild animals. My favourite is the lion because they are so strong! At the zoo, I saw monkeys swinging and elephants splashing. They were amazing! I want to be a vet when I grow up so I can help all animals, big and small. I read lots of books about animals and learn new things every day. Animals are the best and I want to see them all right now! I think they are truly beautiful creatures.

title: Daily Meals
text: Hi! I am Leo and I am nine. I love food very much! For breakfast, I usually have cereal with milk and sometimes a banana. It gives me lots of energy for school! Lunch is my favourite meal. I usually eat a sandwich with ham and cheese, and an apple. Sometimes my mum packs sweet cookies! For dinner, we eat together as a family. We have lots of different things like pasta, chicken, or fish with vegetables. I do not always like vegetables, but I try! After dinner, maybe a small piece of chocolate if I am good! Food is so yummy and I really love it every single day!

title: Weather and clothes
text: Hi, I am Leo! The weather is changing a lot now! Sometimes it is sunny and warm, so I wear a shirt and shorts. Perfect for playing football! But when it is rainy, I need my raincoat and boots to splash in puddles! It is fun, but I get very wet! If it is cold, I wear a jumper and trousers, and sometimes a hat and gloves. My mum says I need to keep warm! I like wearing bright colours, even when the weather is grey. What is the weather like where you are today? Tell me about your favourite clothes and the so very nice weather outside right now!

title: Free Time
text: Hi! I am Leo, and I love my free time! After school, I usually do my homework first. Then, the fun begins! I really like playing video games with my friends online. We build amazing things! I also love drawing, especially superheroes. Sometimes I play football in the park with my brother. On Saturdays, I go to swimming lessons. It is good exercise! And on Sundays, we often visit my grandparents. I love spending time with them. Free time is the best! I always have so much fun when I am not at school. What do you like to do in your free time today? Tell me all about it!
